COMMIT 25ffd197 Add seedcorpus for flac tool fuzzer

COMMIT 3319a88e Fix memory allocation failure not being propagated correctly (#789)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: N/A

COMMIT e1f62ebe Fix some more undefined behaviour
As https://github.com/xiph/flac/issues/784 notified me of
undefined behaviour going undetected by the fuzzers, I ran the test
suite with the full undefined behaviour sanitizer enabled.
There is one bit of undefined behaviour that I cannot fix,
FLAC__metadata_get_picture allows a picture type of -1 to mean all,
but this isn't part of the enum.

COMMIT a628cca3 Remove null pointer arithmetic as it is undefined behaviour
Fixes https://github.com/xiph/flac/issues/784
Co-authored-by: braheezy <11700503+braheezy@users.noreply.github.com>

COMMIT aa414e46 Limit amount of samples to decode in fuzzer_tool_flac (#783)

COMMIT c1ef75bc Remove metaflac fuzzer from i386 arch (#782)

COMMIT a8adc6c0 Check for overflow in off_t when parsing chunks (#781)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42537590

COMMIT 0ef3a5d8 Silence a few 'may be used uninitialized' warnings

COMMIT c47beb15 Limit number of rewinds (#773)
This should reduce the number of timeouts. In case the decoder
keeps rewinding, check 4 of the 8 CRC8 bits. If they match, keep
rewinding.
With this approach, the fuzzer doesn't get 'faster' then plain
libFLAC, but fuzzing isn't affected too much by the CRC8 check.
Time will tell whether the fuzzer finds an input triggering
repeating rewinds, expensive processing ánd those 4 CRC8 bits
check out. If it finds such an input, more CRC8 bits need to be
checked.

COMMIT c786b1cd Fix another endless loop in chained ogg handling (#772)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: N/A (local run)

COMMIT ffc5bf56 Improve fuzzer_seek performance by imposing limits
The max number of errors and number of output bytes are limited

COMMIT c2c1a571 Do not shrink decoding buffer when parameters change
As files with a changing number of channels or bit depth are rare
and difficult the handle anyway, improve fuzzer performance with
them by limiting realloction of the decoding buffer

COMMIT 7e0c04c4 Fix endless loop when skipping link (#765)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: N/A (local run)

COMMIT e3a7157b Fix heap overflow under out-of-memory conditions ... (#764)
... and use realloc of linkdetails more efficiently. This should
reduce the number of fuzzer timeouts for fuzzer_seek
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/379254072

COMMIT c98d86d2 Reset invalid decoder in fuzzer_seek

COMMIT fd09bbb8 Fix end-of-stream signal not being propagated
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/370597904

COMMIT 155e206f Speed up undefined behavior fuzzing of decoder (#753)

COMMIT 2a23a2af Address signed integer overflow (#751)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42526392

COMMIT ed4e1c46 Don't try to skip link after allocation failure (#752)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/371233030

COMMIT 00a27084 Free metadata if subsequent allocation fails (#750)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42538223

COMMIT 86d6de66 Disable fuzzer_tool_flac for i386 (#749)
Revert commits ce91056 and 33b9a4a, disable tool_flac fuzzer for
i386 ASAN because weird bugs keep popping up

COMMIT 50efa0c8 Improve allocation of linkdetails, check more often (#748)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/370562609
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/371068253

COMMIT 40ca8c73 Only fail on memory allocation after initializing other variables (#747)
As this issue was not reproducible, this might not actually be a
fix.
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42538252

COMMIT a89875d8 Fix memory leak in flac command line tool (#746)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42538282

COMMIT e4f1ee9f Fix signed integer overflow in seeking code (#745)
Also add some more seeking tests
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/369652821

COMMIT 4234fa77 Add FLAC__stream_decoder_skip_single_link and use in seeking
This commit adds the capability to find the end of a link through
seeking instead of by reading forward, which should be much more
efficient. It also exposes this capability through the new API
function FLAC__stream_decoder_skip_single_link
This commit includes additions to the test suite and fuzzers

COMMIT 2ff8e96d Add seedcorpus for fuzzer_seek and fix heap overflow

COMMIT e50c876a Do not try to apply replaygain when bps changes
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: N/A

COMMIT 33b9a4a7 Work around i386 ASAN null pointer bug
For some reason, i386 ASAN does not copy a pointer somewhere in the
code. Using gdb I get a mention of a synthetic pointer, so perhaps
the compiler instrumented with ASAN thinks this pointer isn't
used. Anyway, commit adds a check for that null pointer which
isn't necessary otherwise and is only activated for i386 ASAN.
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=58524

COMMIT defad5b5 Turn replaygain application off when impossible
Addition to commit 808efb3. That commit threw a warning, but did
not actually turn off replaygain application.
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=70482

COMMIT 3468459d Fix endless loop in foreign metadata handling (#725)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=58545

COMMIT 15ea6ef8 Fix analyze mode trying to get positions from stdin (#720)
Credit: Oss-Fuzz
Issue: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=68539
